definitions.ask: How long should a background agent runner wait out a busy agent index before failing the launch?
definitions.why: Far beyond any healthy lock hold, yet short next to a dependency wait

choices.label: Covers checkpoint and WAL-recovery stalls on a loaded host; a wedged index fails in a minute
Fails a wedged index sooner but leaves less headroom on a loaded host
Tolerates very long stalls but hides a wedged index behind a long silent boot
